newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghanistan's Taleban to monitor Islamic prayers.
newsitem.headline: Afghanistan's Taleban to monitor Islamic prayers.

text.p: Afghanistan's ruling Taleban movement said on Thursday it would punish Moslems who fail to perform their five-times-a-day Islamic prayers in the capital Kabul.

A Taleban order broadcast by official Kabul radio, monitored in Islamabad, said units of the government's Amar Bel Maruf wa Nahi Anil Munkar (promoting good and fighting evil) department would check observance.
It asked all citizens, including shopkeepers and government employees, to stop work on hearing the muezzin's call for prayers and go to mosques.

The Taleban, which captured Kabul in late September from the ousted government of president Burhanuddin Rabbani, has enforced a strict Islamic code in the more than two-thirds of Afghanistan under its control.
